title: Ormacar
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Ormacar , Relic Wraith , is an elf wraith from an unknown plane.

The character of Ormacar was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2023 Heroes of the Realm program. It appears to be a humanoid made of darkness contained in armor, wielding a sword giving off blue energy and a glowing ring.
The card was designed by Jeremy Geist and given as a reward for the The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth ' s Design and Development team.

Ormacar's name may be a combination of two elements: or , which is French for "gold", and Macar , Magic's version of the mythical character of Midas . This could convey the meaning that the winners of the card turned everything into gold. Its epithet, "Relic Wraith," is a reference to Lord of the Rings 's Ringwraiths . Its mechanic, Precious , is a reference to the term used by ring-bearers to refer to the One Ring . Its power and toughness are written as "001/001," a reference to the serialized version of The One Ring
